verdict.rationale: Smooth is API-first. Its REST API covers running tasks, interactive sessions (goto, extract, evaluate_js, close), listing and cancelling tasks, custom tools, structured output, proxies and browser profiles, and there is an official CLI for agents. However, no source says the API matches the UI, and some flows lean on human UI use: profile logins are done 'manually', and live-view takeover is interactive. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account, billing and profile management, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found all candidate paths 404), and independent corroboration.
